name: Should I hang drywall myself or hire a professional?

mainEntity.name: Should I hang drywall myself or hire a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many homeowners in Denver, Centennial, Greenwood Village, Foxfield, and Parker hire a pro when the project includes ceilings, tall walls, tricky cuts, or a tight timeline. Professional hanging also helps when you want flatter seams, fewer screw pops, and less risk of damaging electrical or plumbing lines hidden in the wall.
acceptedAnswer.description: DIY can work for small, simple areas, but a pro is usually better for ceilings, tall walls, and fast timelines. Professional hanging also reduces the risk of uneven seams and hidden utility damage.
